$comment: Internal server OpenVPN runtime settings. Public computer access is lan[].share in ../app/launcher/config.paste.schema.json: subnets, split-DNS domains, dnsServers (up to four IPv4 inside subnets), enabled (default true); deprecated forwards are ignored on the computer and omitted from config export. OpenVPN credentials remain on the server.
title: RemoteAgents restricted LAN settings

server_fingerprint.description: Optional SHA-256 pin of the gateway certificate, set by --server-fingerprint; replaces remote-cert-tls server.

endpoints.description: Optional client-independent transport allowlist; lan_vpn.endpoints validates canonical globally routable IPv4 (no multicast/reserved).

subnets.description: Canonical RFC1918 IPv4 CIDRs only; lan_vpn.networks validates address semantics.
